player_prompt.intro:
Qam kawak {player_id} Indian Poker pukllapi.
- 52-karta baraja; qam rikunki k'umpa karta.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) sapa ronda, {max_rounds} ronda(s) tukuy.
- Kanan kuyukuykuna: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X positivo integer <= qam chip cuenta.)
- Aswan ukhu karta atipanqa p'unchaypi.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Q'umirlla huklla bracketed acción, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', o '[fold]'.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: [bet X] nisqawan kicharichiy; mana ima apuestapis jatarinchu.
